title: Introduction
intro: What the manual is: a complete reference to all components and models Daisy provides, with their parameters, state variables and log variables, generated automatically from the code and listed alphabetically in part II. It is not an introduction to the model, a tutorial or a programmers manual.

title: Concepts
intro: Components, models and parameterizations: a component is a group of exchangeable models (for example crop, bioclimate, soil horizon), a model is one implementation, and a parameterization is a model with chosen attribute values. Attributes can be optional, have defaults, and be log variables.
